This evolution means that deep contextual knowledge of how administrative and alternative data sources must be managed and integrated into statistical programs increases in importance, as does methodological awareness of advanced and automated sampling approaches and the ability to assess coverage, quality, and the fitness-for-purpose of new data assets.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Set up collection
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The Unit Head, Subject Matter (EC-06) is responsible for managing and coordinating studies, developing new methods for producing and analyzing data, and proposing enhancements to program content and operational procedures, which includes recommending modifications to program coverage, data sources, and operational systems. For example, the work description specifically references developing options and strategies to manage complex issues and multi-stakeholder relations, as well as leading teams responsible for significant multi-sectoral files and operational activities. Future GSBPM expectation: The transition to automated, AI-enabled collection set-up fundamentally shifts system configuration away from routine manual tasks and focuses on integrating alternative data sources, system interoperability, and template-driven deployments. Human work pivots to oversight, exception handling, and risk management rather than hands-on configuration. Role evolution: The Unit Head will migrate from bespoke instrument development and direct operational oversight toward validating logic and outcomes produced by automated systems, supervising exception management, and adapting operational models to maximize reuse and rapid system deployment. Decision-making shifts from detailed setup specification to high-level platform monitoring and risk/ethics oversight. Capability implication: It becomes increasingly important for the Unit Head to understand automated pipeline logic, data integration from alternate sources, platform security, and AI operations. Oversight—not hands-on execution—requires evaluative and governance knowledge, as well as risk assessment and the ability to intervene in system-detected exceptions.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Run collection
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification:
Current responsibility: The 'Unit Head, Subject Matter' (EC-06) manages and coordinates studies, provides expert advice to data users, and leads project teams responsible for significant programs and operational issues. Decision-making includes 'developing enhancements and recommending modifications to be made to the program content, coverage and operational procedures, such as new or modified data sources, concepts, methods and definitions to be applied.'
Future GSBPM expectation: The shift to automated, multi-source collection pipelines means all program enhancements, operational strategies, and data acquisition initiatives now must be designed to work within a digitally automated, AI-enabled environment. Manual respondent management and direct fieldwork become rare, requiring leadership in orchestrating human-in-the-loop exception handling, quality monitoring, and integrating new data feeds.
Role evolution: The Unit Head will need to reframe operational improvement initiatives toward the design, integration, and ongoing refinement of digital acquisition methods and automation platforms. Process supervision, project direction, and stakeholder engagement shift to a landscape of system monitoring, real-time dashboard adjustments, and escalation management for complex cases. The role demands proactive system integration strategy and continuous improvement oversight of automated collection workflows, rather than manual process management.
Capability implication: The ability to design and manage multi-source, event-driven collection systems; interpret and act on real-time paradata signals; and govern exception-handling protocols for digital survey platforms becomes increasingly essential.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Integrate data
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: The 'Unit Head, Subject Matter' currently plans, develops, and directs analysis and review of program results, coordinates and reviews development, processing, analysis, and dissemination, and develops new methods to produce, evaluate, analyze, and extend divisional statistics. The current model involves hands-on oversight for integrating data from diverse sources, frequently addressing conceptual differences and compatibility manually or through custom processes ('Programs involve a combination of statistical techniques and methods and the integration of data from a variety of sources'). With the future GSBPM, integration becomes automated, using standardized, modular components rather than manually managing data harmonization or linkage. The role’s oversight would transition from managing bespoke integration requirements and troubleshooting technical and conceptual conflicts to governing integration architectures, developing metadata-driven rules, and monitoring exception outcomes in real-time pipelines. The role would focus more on the strategic configuration and governance of platforms, ensuring compliance with standardized input/output interfaces and auditability while facilitating cross-domain deployments. This elevates the importance of deep metadata stewardship, governance of platform-based processes, and managing exception logic rather than operational linking routines.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Classify and code
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-06 Unit Head, Subject Matter, supervises and manages the analysis, review, and presentation of program results as well as coordinates development, processing, analysis, marketing, and dissemination of statistical data. The role involves developing new methods to produce, evaluate, analyze and extend statistical outputs—including involvement in conceptualizing, modifying, and leading teams for coding, classification, and related operational routines. This includes decision-making on standards, concepts, and operational approaches for statistical processing. Future GSBPM expectation: The Classify and code subprocess moves to AI-enabled, modular routines, with central code lists and auditability. Human intervention becomes exception-driven, focusing on model validation, oversight, maintaining classification frameworks, and updating schemes based on new evidence or requirements. The bulk of coding is automated, requiring oversight, not direct operational management. Role evolution: The Unit Head will pivot from managing manual coding activities to a focus on governance of automated pipelines, exception handling, validation feedback loops, updating classification schemes, and ensuring standardized approaches across domains. They must oversee pipeline operation, audit compliance, and risk mitigation in AI-enabled environments, and redirect their teams to oversight, validation, and improvement activities. Capability implication: Comprehensive knowledge of model governance, pipeline monitoring, exception management, system validation, and centralized classification maintenance—as well as an enhanced grasp of AI ethics and audit routines—becomes essential, together with strong subject matter to steer the evolution of classification standards.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Review and validate
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: The Unit Head, Subject Matter (EC-06) is responsible for reviewing and coordinating the 'development, processing, analysis, marketing and dissemination of statistical data;', additionally, they plan, manage, and coordinate studies and develop new methods for producing, evaluating, analyzing, and presenting statistics. As validation transitions to automated pipelines, the Unit Head must shift from approving or coordinating manual review procedures to overseeing the integration and continuous improvement of automated validation logic, tracking automated error detection performance, and managing exception review processes at scale. The focus evolves to establishing and enforcing governance of validation standards, collaborating on rule refinement, and ensuring auditability and transparency of validation steps across programs rather than maintaining survey-specific manual procedures. This increases the importance of understanding pipeline orchestration, validation rule governance, and exception management in statistical production.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Edit and impute
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification:
Current responsibility: The EC-06 Data Production and Dissemination Development Officer plans, develops, directs, and supervises the creation and review of program results related to processing, editing, and dissemination. The role includes leading project teams, developing new methods for statistical processing, and advising stakeholders on processing and editing approaches. They are involved in interpreting study findings, modifying operational procedures and overseeing implementation of adapted data processing systems.

Future GSBPM expectation: The future state of GSBPM 5.4 includes a wholesale transition to automated, modular, and AI-enabled edit/impute pipelines. The role shifts from direct supervision of editing personnel or development of bespoke methods to oversight of AI-driven microservices embedded in cross-domain platforms, with responsibilities concentrated in governance, exception management, performance validation, and compliance.

Role evolution: The EC-06 officer will need to manage the integration and governance of automated edit/impute tools, ensuring traceability, standardization, and reproducibility of processes across programs. The focus shifts toward process orchestration, auditability, and aligning pipeline interventions with ethical and regulatory standards. Their advisory and consultative activities increasingly concern interpretation of AI system outputs, handling exceptions, and managing risk-based escalations rather than hands-on statistical methods.

Capability implication: The role will increasingly emphasize understanding of automation frameworks, ethical oversight of AI, performance evaluation of automated edit/impute modules, audit requirements, and standardized component design rather than manual editing know-how.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Derive new variables and units
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The Unit Head, Subject Matter (EC-06) plans, develops and directs the analysis, review and presentation of program results and manages or leads teams responsible for developing new methods to produce and analyze divisional statistics. This includes developing options and strategies to manage complex issues, representing divisions in development projects or committees, and determining standards, data concepts, and definitions in study design and outputs. These tasks currently include hands-on involvement in derivation of variables—often through analyst-driven coding and bespoke transformations—and evaluating conceptual frameworks. Future GSBPM expectation: By 2030, derivation of new variables and units moves from manual execution to automated, metadata-driven modules orchestrated in auditable pipelines. Analysts focus on designing transformation logic and governing its quality and compliance rather than performing ad hoc derivations. Role evolution: The Unit Head will transition from directly overseeing manual derivations to stewarding transformation logic as reusable, centrally governed modules. They will manage the integration and deployment of standardized microservices for derivation, ensure compliance with metadata standards, and oversee exception handling, audit trails, and rapid updates. Decision-making shifts from custom solutioning to evaluating and approving standardized logic and managing pipeline governance, cross-domain module reuse, and traceability. Capability implication: In this environment, mastery of metadata modeling, modular transformation design, and pipeline governance becomes central. Deep knowledge of how derivation logic relates to domain concepts and compliance frameworks is required. Capacity for collaborating on cross-team module development, impact analysis of upstream changes, and managing auditability and reproducibility is increasingly critical.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Calculate weights
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: The Unit Head, Subject Matter (EC-06) is tasked with 'plans, manages and coordinates economic, financial and/or socio-economic studies and develops new methods to produce, evaluate, analyze, present and extend the application of divisional statistics' and 'reviews the conceptual framework of existing statistical programs and determines the need for development, modification and adaption,' including integration of diverse sources and development of statistical methodologies. The future GSBPM phase requires that weighting methods be designed and maintained for automated, modular pipelines, emphasizing digital asset management, reproducibility, cross-domain compatibility, and auditable operations. This alters the Unit Head’s role from overseeing operational teams conducting manual or semi-automated weight calculation, to providing governance of weight calculation methodology as implemented in system modules, reviewing pipeline performance, and supporting exception handling and recalibration processes. The capability focus shifts toward governing and designing weighting modules suitable for automation, understanding systems requirements for embedded standards, and facilitating traceability, metadata-driven implementation, and adaptive AI logic, not case-by-case manual adjustment.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Calculate aggregates
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The Unit Head is responsible for planning, developing, and directing the analysis, review and presentation of program results, developing new methods to produce, evaluate, analyze, and extend statistical outputs, and supervising project teams developing new or modified data sources, concepts, methods, and definitions. This involves oversight of aggregation approaches and review of statistical procedures. Future GSBPM expectation: With aggregation modules standardized and automated, the Unit Head’s role will focus on configuring pipelines to meet specific program needs, validating and interpreting modular aggregation outputs, supervising exception handling in automated pipelines, and ensuring compliance with standards for auditability, transparency, and reproducibility. Role evolution: The Unit Head must become adept at managing the transition to centrally governed, version-controlled aggregation processes, balancing program-specific requirements with enterprise-standard modules, and directing staff to focus on configuration, validation, and interpretive activities rather than manual output creation. Capability implication: Greater importance is placed on the understanding of modular pipeline architectures, metadata governance, automated validation processes, audit trail management, and ensuring that program-specific needs are addressed via configuration and not custom development.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Prepare draft outputs
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-06 Unit Head, Subject Matter plans, develops, and directs the analysis, review, and presentation of program results and 'prepares, edits and evaluates analytical material for publication purposes.' This position organizes and supervises teams involved in the analytical review and dissemination process, focusing heavily on technical preparation and formatting of draft outputs. Future GSBPM expectation: StatCan2030 will automate the bulk of output preparation, shifting responsibility to oversight of automated pipelines and the interpretation of AI-generated outputs rather than technical drafting. Role evolution: The Unit Head will need to lead teams in system/pipeline management, performance tracking, agile template updates, and exception review, moving away from manual production tasks to managing automated processes and ensuring robust quality oversight. Capability implication: Deep knowledge in analytical pipeline configuration and exception-driven review, as well as expertise in managing reproducibility, traceability, and oversight of machine-generated outputs, become critical for this role.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Validate outputs
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The Unit Head manages analysis, review, and presentation of program results, including reviewing development, processing, analysis, and dissemination of statistical data. This includes coordination and review of validation activities and quality assurance across teams ('Plans, develops and directs the analysis, review and presentation of program results; coordinates and reviews the development, processing, analysis, marketing and dissemination ...'). The job involves recommending modifications to operational procedures and ensuring quality output. Future GSBPM expectation: As validation becomes AI-automated, oversight shifts to monitoring automated pipelines, updating validation logic, and ensuring exceptional handling and auditability. Human oversight is required for interpretation of anomalies and assurance of transparency and trust in automated validation processes. Role evolution: The Unit Head must adapt from managing teams conducting manual reviews to leading teams overseeing automated validation processes, developing strategies to handle exceptions, and governing validation pipeline standards. Capability implication: Broad knowledge in orchestrated validation tools, automated quality assurance frameworks, and audit trail governance will be of greater importance. They will need to ensure alignment of automated pipelines with statistical standards, oversee metadata-driven QA, and interpret results from automated anomaly detection.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Interpret and explain outputs
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-06 Unit Head, Subject Matter plans, develops, and directs the analysis, review, and presentation of program results, prepares and evaluates analytical material for publication, provides expert advisory services to policy makers and stakeholders, and interprets study findings and conclusions for management advice and recommendations ("Provides expert advisory and consultative services to policy makers at all levels of government, business and national social agencies and academics and presents rationale on the practical application and interpretation of statistical data and information"). Future GSBPM expectation: The future state calls for expert contextual interpretation of automated outputs, ensuring findings are accessible with ethical transparency and oversight. Narrative interpretation, connection to client needs, and communication of methodological limits become central. Role evolution: The Unit Head will shift from mixed technical and interpretation tasks to specializing in ensuring the policy relevance, ethical framing, and accessibility of AI-generated results, while embedding oversight for fairness and transparency. Capability implication: Importance increases for contextual knowledge, policy impact assessment, ethical communication, and oversight of automated methods. The role now requires deep knowledge of human-AI collaboration in statistical analysis and stewardship.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Apply disclosure control
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The Unit Head, Subject Matter (EC-06) is accountable for planning, developing, and directing analysis and presentation of program results, managing program enhancements including confidentiality of information, and supervising multi-disciplinary project teams. The description states 'provides input to management decisions ... develops new program initiatives covering areas such as ... confidentiality of information.' Future GSBPM expectation: The modernization embeds disclosure control into automated pipelines, requiring oversight, validation, and escalation processes for exceptions and new output formats. Role evolution: The Unit Head's responsibilities will evolve from supervising manual disclosure review to overseeing the integration of disclosure rules and AI-powered modules into team workflows, ensuring disclosure control features are built in, or supervising teams responsible for exception handling, audit trails, and ongoing policy updates as outputs diversify. Capability implication: The Unit Head will need enhanced familiarity with automated disclosure systems design, transparent audit processes, real-time monitoring, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure robust and ethical disclosure control is operational throughout the pipeline.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: GSBPM 6.5 Finalise Outputs
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The Unit Head, Subject Matter is responsible for coordinating the review, analysis, dissemination, and presentation of program results, managing operational units and multi-disciplinary teams, and overseeing analytical material prepared for publication. These activities encompass directing manual output preparation, review, and dissemination workflows, as seen in: 'Plans, develops and directs the analysis, review and presentation of program results; coordinates and reviews the development, processing, analysis, marketing and dissemination of statistical data; prepares, edits and evaluates analytical material for publication purposes.' Future GSBPM expectation: Output finalization will be embedded in automated, reproducible analytical pipelines, and the focus will move toward interpretation, oversight, and strategic sign-off rather than direct management of manual consistency checks or preparation activities. Role evolution: The Unit Head must adapt to managing teams that oversee, audit, and intervene in automated workflows, focusing on exception handling, system monitoring, and maintaining quality standards where outputs are finalized rapidly and reproducibly by automated processes. Capability implication: The importance of knowledge in automated pipeline oversight, strategic evaluation of flagged outputs, and trust management in AI-driven documentation and output preparation will increase. Understanding orchestration and exception management in statistical output systems will be key.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Update output systems
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification:
Current responsibility: The 'Unit Head, Subject Matter' (EC-06) plans and directs the analysis, review, and presentation of program results, coordinates and reviews development, processing, analysis, marketing, and dissemination of statistical data, prepares and edits analytical material, and manages project teams. They determine standards, data concepts, definitions, and techniques to be applied in reporting, analysis, and presentation of findings. Evidence: 'Plans, develops and directs the analysis, review and presentation of program results; coordinates and reviews the development, processing, analysis, marketing and dissemination of statistical data; prepares, edits and evaluates analytical material for publication purposes.'

Future GSBPM expectation: Dissemination of statistical outputs will be automated, metadata-driven, and governed by enterprise standards. The role will now require ensuring that program outputs are machine-actionable, standardized, and interoperable, with modular and reusable dissemination components for real-time publication.

Role evolution: The Unit Head will need to shift from coordinating program-level dissemination activities to ensuring that program results are prepared with the appropriate metadata and configuration for enterprise-level publication platforms. Their oversight will evolve into guaranteeing compliance with central standards, managing exceptions, and contributing to the evolution of metadata schemas and dissemination standards.

Capability implication: In-depth familiarity with enterprise metadata structures, API publication processes, and modular dissemination standards will be required. The ability to ensure subject-matter outputs are compatible with centralized automated systems and to participate in continuous improvement of metadata standards is increasingly critical.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Promote dissemination products
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-06 Unit Head, Subject Matter, is responsible for coordinating and reviewing the marketing and dissemination of statistical data, and for preparing, editing, and evaluating analytical material for publication purposes. The work description notes 'coordinates and reviews the development, processing, analysis, marketing and dissemination of statistical data,' and provides guidance on dissemination methods and systems. Future GSBPM expectation: 'Promote dissemination products' is expected to shift from traditional manual marketing and web publication to automated, AI-driven, machine-actionable, and metadata-rich approaches. Promotion will proactively facilitate discovery for human and machine users, using APIs, digital channels, and real-time engagement analytics. Role evolution: This role must evolve from managing publication processes and manual marketing to overseeing automated digital promotion, ensuring metadata standards for machine discoverability, optimizing digital channels for user-centric outreach, and monitoring engagement analytics to drive promotion strategies. Capability implication: The Unit Head must deepen operational understanding of metadata management and digital discoverability, integrate expertise in API-driven promotional logic, and extend knowledge of engagement analytics and personalization principles vital to modern digital outreach and trust-building in a digital ecosystem.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Gather evaluation inputs
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification:
Current responsibility: The Unit Head, Subject Matter (EC-06) plans, manages, and coordinates studies, reviews analytical material, and recommends modifications to program content and operational procedures based on assessed quality and performance ('Reviews the conceptual framework of existing statistical programs and determines the need for development, modification and adaption... Assesses and reviews statistical techniques, methods and approaches used in the collection, processing, analysis and dissemination of data within a program area...'). The role involves interpreting study findings and making recommendations for program enhancements based on manually gathered evaluation inputs from various stakeholders and operational processes.
Future GSBPM expectation: The gathering of evaluation inputs is now automated and continuous, relying on system instrumentation. Staff focus on dashboard monitoring, indicator design, and exception handling rather than periodic manual compilation and review.
Role evolution: The Unit Head's responsibilities thus evolve to configuring and validating automated evaluation frameworks, ensuring the completeness and relevance of system-generated evaluation material, interpreting operational performance and quality metrics, and managing responses to anomaly alerts or situations where automated inputs are insufficient.
Capability implication: Deeper operational knowledge of automated evaluation systems, quality indicator design, and interpretation of system-paradata and process metrics become essential, as does the ability to collaborate with system designers to ensure that evaluation data design meets analytical and program needs.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Conduct evaluation
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-06 'Unit Head, Subject Matter' is responsible for directing analysis, review, and presentation of program results—including the assessment of program effectiveness, coordination of methodological improvements, and development of recommendations to senior management. Traditional evaluation relies on review cycles, manual analysis, and retrospective reporting ("prepares recommendations and advice to senior management" and "reviews the conceptual framework of existing statistical programs"). Future GSBPM expectation: Moving toward real-time, system-driven evaluation, the focus becomes interpreting embedded performance and quality signals, addressing system-generated alerts, benchmarking against standards, and supporting iterative, logged improvements while reducing the emphasis on extensive narrative reporting. Role evolution: The Unit Head must integrate continuous, dashboard-based evaluation oversight into team and program management, ensure prompt translation of system performance evidence into actionable interventions, and move from orchestrating cyclical, large-scale overhauls to facilitating frequent, responsive, and traceable modular changes. Capability implication: This drives the need for expertise in managing performance through dashboards, orchestrating cross-functional interventions based on real-time metrics, and translating technical dashboard signals into program direction, priorities, and recommendations within an automated and iterative evaluation framework.

Unit Head, Subject Matter.title: Agree an action plan
Unit Head, Subject Matter.justification:
Current responsibility: The Unit Head (EC-06) is responsible for planning, developing, and directing the review and analysis of program results, managing multi-disciplinary teams, and developing strategies for divisional programs ('Develops options and strategies to manage complex issues and multi-stakeholder relations'; 'Leads project teams for significant files'). The position coordinates operational plans and is often accountable for following through on operational actions and responses to program evaluation.

Future GSBPM expectation: The future state requires action planning to be streamlined, aligned with standard/automated workflows, and integrated with mechanisms for ongoing monitoring, timely recalibration, and transparent progress tracking. Plans are not static but are underpinned by ongoing feedback from automated systems, requiring explicit ownership and visible progress updates.

Role evolution: The Unit Head will shift from developing multi-year strategies and acting upon periodic evaluation findings to rapidly developing, operationalizing, and iterating action plans within modular and often automated program structures. This involves leveraging digital platforms for assignment, progress tracking, and evidence-based adjustment, and embedding action plan management into daily operations instead of as infrequent, discrete events.

Capability implication: The position will need deep understanding of automated tracking platforms, modular workflow alignment, and the skills to interpret and act rapidly on digital feedback/impact information. It will require greater emphasis on adaptive operational management within digital ecosystems, as well as fostering transparency and accountability at the team level.

Chief.title: Identify needs
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief manages a section and/or multidisciplinary project teams, plans long-term strategies, proposes new or modified statistical programs, initiates and implements new systems/processes, and evaluates the cost, efficiency, and productivity of statistical systems ('Establishes strategic directions for the management of significant studies, proposes innovative solutions and recommends to senior officials of Statistics Canada new or modified statistical programs to address departmental goals and objectives'). Future GSBPM expectation: The identification of needs is formalized through enterprise-wide digital platforms, requires business intelligence-driven scans of internal/external data, formal cost-benefit/resource/risk automation triage, and moves surveys to a last resort after automation and reuse are exhausted. Role evolution: The Chief will be required to lead the adoption of digital, automated needs identification frameworks, establish and manage data asset inventories, ensure cross-program coordination in triage, oversee justification processes for new collections, and integrate cost/resource/automation considerations into strategic planning. Capability implication: Ability to lead digital transformation of needs identification processes, integrate enterprise business intelligence and automation into program initiation and evaluation, and steer teams toward solution-first, sustainable approaches under resource and strategic priorities.

Chief.title: Consult and Confirm Needs
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The 'Chief' manages multidisciplinary teams for statistical program operations and long-term program strategy, establishes a framework for the development and operation of statistical systems, and evaluates the impact of changes in technology and subject area. The role establishes strategic directions for studies, proposes new or modified programs, manages complex studies, and identifies new data sources for client needs. It conceptualizes enhancements to programs and initiates changes to meet client demands. Future GSBPM expectation: The focus will be on leveraging existing and alternative data sources, using automated platforms for rapid, transparent consultation, and rigorous justification for new surveys only when reuse does not suffice. Role evolution: The Chief will need to transition from traditional survey advocacy toward rapid, evidence-based asset review and outcome-focused stakeholder engagement. Strategic planning and program evolution will increasingly involve iterative, platform-supported needs confirmation, enabling transparency and efficiency. Capability implication: The role must develop deeper capability in platform-driven asset evaluation, agile stakeholder consultation, cross-functional integration for prioritized decision-making, and transparent articulation of trade-off and cost-benefit analyses.

Chief.title: Establish output objectives
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief manages statistical sections, defines objectives/content of research, evaluates all functions of statistical systems design, and initiates changes to meet client demands including 'identifies the availability and reliability of new data sources.' They set strategic direction for new or modified programs and directly impact objective setting (see: '[Establishes strategic directions for the management of significant studies, proposes innovative solutions and recommends... new or modified statistical programs to address departmental goals and objectives.]'). Future GSBPM expectation: Objective-setting will require up-front demonstration of automation readiness, prioritization of asset reuse, and digital workflow compatibility. The Chief will be expected to ensure output objectives are tightly scoped, optimized for interoperability and machine-actionability, and formally justified before approval, especially for any survey-based solutions. Role evolution: The Chief will need to lead multidisciplinary teams in evaluating and documenting feasibility within digital and automation parameters, apply stricter criteria for survey necessity, and proactively manage the integration of existing assets and automation technologies when setting program objectives. Capability implication: Advanced understanding of automation frameworks, digital interoperability, time/cost/resource trade-off evaluation, and integration of machine-actionable output requirements with subject-matter expertise.

Chief.title: Identify Concepts
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages a section responsible for the operation and development of statistical systems including conceptual frameworks, making decisions about the objectives, content, and methodology for research and development work (decision_making | 'Establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems and processes... Plans and manages the review and evaluation of statistical program methods and concepts...'). The role also encompasses strategic innovation and advising on new or modified concepts, theories, and practices (communication and knowledge_of_specialized_fields). Future GSBPM expectation: Identification of statistical concepts is machine-driven and system-guided, with recurring needs for human arbitration of strategic priorities, validation of exceptions, and establishment of consistent frameworks for digital integration. Role evolution: The Chief must transition from manual conceptualization to guiding arbitration processes, steering alignment across multiple teams and domains, and validating the suitability of AI-derived conceptual assets for statistical programs and pipelines. Capability implication: Strategic enterprise thinking about metadata structures, interoperability, arbitration and negotiation, and digital integration become critical, alongside the ability to interpret and contextualize machine-generated conceptual frameworks for programmatic relevance.

Chief.title: Check data availability and suitability
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 'Chief' plans and implements strategies for statistical program development, enhancement, and operation. They initiate changes and implement new systems, manage studies of data quality and completeness, and identify the availability and reliability of new data sources. The Chief manages large teams and is responsible for expert advisory services and negotiation around statistical programs and methodologies. Future GSBPM expectation: Automation transforms the data discovery and source evaluation process, making source canvassing and suitability screening rapid, system-driven, and metadata-enabled. Chiefs must now ensure oversight and validation of automated processes, resolve complex partnership negotiations, and defend survey launches with clear evidence from automated tools. Human effort increasingly focuses on legal/ethical risk management, managing access rights, and strategic ecosystem maintenance. Role evolution: The Chief must become adept at interpreting complex automated screening outcomes, leading interdisciplinary teams focused on legal, technical, and partnership issues, and strategically managing the shift to metadata-driven decision-making. Their role evolves to champion technology-enabled processes and manage rare, complex cases requiring higher-order analysis. Capability implication: Mastery of metadata-driven platforms, automated decision logic, procurement and negotiation principles, and legal/risk management for alternative data partnerships becomes more critical. The Chief will need comprehensive technical understanding of system-wide data asset inventories and suitability processes, and the ability to mobilize specialized teams for edge-case resolution.

Chief.title: Prepare and submit business case
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief manages program operations and initiates changes, including implementing new systems and processes, evaluating costs and efficiency, and establishing strategic directions for major studies. Statements like 'Establishes strategic directions for the management of significant studies, proposes innovative solutions and recommends to senior officials... new or modified statistical programs' and 'Initiates changes and implements new systems and processes to meet client demands' illustrate the leadership in business case formulation. Future GSBPM expectation: Business cases must demonstrate empirical alignment to automation-first, non-survey data use, and modular approaches; justification for surveys requires clear trade-off analyses and alignment with enterprise priorities. Role evolution: The Chief must adapt responsibilities to focus on rapidly creating, evaluating, and defending business cases centered on automation and strategic alignment, minimizing manual or bespoke solutions. Decision making shifts to transparent evidence-driven gating rather than incremental advocacy for traditional approaches. Capability implication: The ability to frame, defend, and iterate business cases based on empirical cost-benefit, risk assessment, and automation alignment becomes vital, along with collaboration across disciplines for outcome-oriented options analysis.

Chief.title: Design outputs and dissemination
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief manages a section or teams involved in statistical operations, analysis, marketing and dissemination, implements new systems and processes, sets the framework for collection, processing, analysis, and dissemination, and manages complex studies with substantial impact on dissemination practices. The Chief also establishes policies and procedures for security and confidentiality of data as related to dissemination. Future GSBPM expectation: Chiefs will be expected to lead the operational transformation toward fully automated, standardized, API-driven dissemination pipelines, integrating metadata schemas and FAIR alignment, and ensuring outputs are both human- and machine-consumable. They will need to oversee platform-based dissemination models, manage differentiated access and confidentiality in automated environments, and foster cross-functional collaboration with IT/data governance. Role evolution: The Chief's accountability expands to include platform and protocol management, specification of interoperable dissemination assets and their integration with automated production systems, and ongoing alignment with emerging metadata and ethical standards. Capability implication: Advanced platform management and metadata competency, protocol specification, and operational oversight of automated and scalable dissemination processes—not just traditional statistical output management—become increasingly important.

Chief.title: Design variables
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages statistical program operations, sets strategic directions for studies, and initiates changes to systems and processes (see: 'establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems and processes and evaluates and incorporates all the functions and activities associated with the data collection, processing, editing, compilation, analysis and dissemination of the division's statistical outputs and assesses the impact of changes in both technology and the subject area'). They manage evaluation of methods and concepts to ensure quality and relevancy across programs. Future GSBPM expectation: With variable design becoming foundational to enterprise automation and interoperability, the Chief must ensure that variable frameworks are standardized, metadata-rich, machine-actionable and aligned with registries and automated pipelines. Role evolution: The Chief will need to embed variable and metadata standardization into operational strategy, facilitate infrastructure for AI-ready, FAIR-compliant variables, and lead their team in curating and maintaining shared variable repositories. Capability implication: Knowledge of enterprise metadata governance, variable registry management, interoperability frameworks, and the broader impact of variable standardization on automated and cross-domain data integration will be essential.

Chief.title: Design collection
Chief.justification: The 'Chief (EC-07)' role is deeply involved in establishing frameworks for statistical systems and integrating new methods, data sources, and technologies to meet evolving client demands, as stated: 'Establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems...assesses the impact of changes in both technology and the subject area.' The GSBPM future state for 'Design collection' fundamentally shifts from manual survey instrument design to automated, AI-driven, and modular data collection, placing primary emphasis on alternative data sources and system-wide integration. The Chief's responsibility for implementing new systems and processes (e.g., 'Initiates changes and implements new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifies and assesses new statistical methods, techniques and practices...') directly aligns with the expectations to enable and oversee these new automated, metadata-driven, interoperable collection designs. This means their activities, decision frameworks, and operational direction must shift from project-driven, manual configuration towards enterprise-level management of automated collection frameworks, system monitoring, and validation of AI processes. As a result, capabilities in supervising automation, configuring modular systems, ensuring interoperability, and managing ethical oversight and exception handling in an AI-driven environment become crucial, requiring an elevated understanding of platform-centric, metadata-enabled design, real-time data acquisition, and automated workflow governance.

Chief.title: Design frame and sample
Chief.justification: EC-07 Chief manages teams implementing new systems/processes, identifies new statistical techniques and methods, and incorporates technology changes across programs ('Implements new systems and processes... identifies and assesses new statistical methods, techniques and practices and the associated costs and limitations, identifies the availability and reliability of new data sources, evaluates the suitability of new hardware and software...'). The transition to automated, metadata-driven, AI-powered pipelines for frame/sample design means the Chief's role becomes more centered on strategic oversight of these platforms, integration of best practices, operationalization standards, evaluation of AI outputs, and quality control for automation. The role should evolve to manage not only implementation of automated workflows but also audit and investigation of edge cases, ensuring interoperability, and cross-program reuse. Capability implication is greater expertise in platform standards, managing metadata-driven automation, AI oversight, integration of administrative/alternative sources, and governance of system outputs.

Chief.title: Design processing and analysis
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The 'Chief' (EC-07) manages sections and project teams for statistical program operations, analysis, and system/process development, planning and implementing strategies for the operation and enhancement of statistical programs. They are responsible for implementing new systems, evaluating statistical methods and concepts, and managing the review and evaluation of program methods to ensure quality and improve data (“Establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems and processes and evaluates and incorporates all the functions and activities associated with the data collection, processing, editing, compilation, analysis and dissemination of the division's statistical outputs”). Future GSBPM expectation: The design phase now requires that all processing and analysis designs be ready for end-to-end automation, modular reuse, and machine-actionability; emphasis is placed on standardized, auditable, template-based workflows configured for real-time operations. Custom, manual design becomes obsolete; everything must be able to rapidly integrate new sources and support AI-enabled analysis. Role evolution: The Chief must lead the reengineering of statistical program operations to adopt and maintain modular, standardized design practices, and to integrate automation logic and metadata-driven validation routines into system specifications. Their leadership will be in ensuring operational resilience, auditability, and rapid deployment—guiding teams to shift from ad hoc manual designs to automation-ready templates, and negotiating technical and governance trade-offs between custom and standardized approaches. Capability implication: Strategic knowledge of metadata systems, automation logic, modular microservices architecture, and orchestration of event-driven design will be vital. The role will need expertise in system configuration, template-based specification, automated validation and edit rule implementation, and cross-domain interoperability principles.

Chief.title: Reuse or build collection instruments
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 'Chief' manages sections and teams involved in statistical program operations; implements strategies for statistical program development, enhancement, and operation; and evaluates and incorporates all functions related to collection, processing, and analysis of outputs. The role includes establishing system development frameworks, managing change, and reviewing methods for the development and operation of statistical systems. Evidence: 'Establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems and processes and evaluates and incorporates all the functions and activities associated with the data collection, processing, editing, compilation, analysis and dissemination...' Future GSBPM expectation: In the automated, modular future, the Chief will be responsible for integrating AI-enabled, metadata-rich, and self-service platforms into statistical operations, facilitating decentralized, platform-based instrument creation across teams, and ensuring systems support interoperability, reuse, digital security and compliance. Role evolution: The Chief's management will emphasize digital transformation, oversight and validation of platform-configured instruments, governance of decentralized workflows, and conformity to enterprise standards and digital guardrails. Capability implication: Critical knowledge areas will involve enterprise automation platforms, governance for decentralized instrument configuration, digital compliance, paradata integration, and management of platform-enabled collection ecosystems.

Chief.title: Reuse or build dissemination components
Chief.justification:
Current responsibility: The EC-07 'Chief' manages sections and project teams involved in analysis, interpretation, marketing, and dissemination, with authority over long-term strategies and implementation of new systems and processes ('Manages a section and/or multidisciplinary project teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, marketing and dissemination.' and 'Plans and implements long term strategies for the development, enhancement and operation of statistical programs.'). The Chief also evaluates strategic changes in systems affecting dissemination.
Future GSBPM expectation: Strategic management must now ensure all dissemination system development and operations are built on modular, reusable, and standardized architectures, with automation and interoperability default requirements. Mission-critical publication is restricted to centrally-governed systems, demanding adoption of platform and quality guardrails.
Role evolution: The Chief must shift from overseeing diverse, custom dissemination process development to enforcing platform-based, automation-oriented system assembly. Strategy and operational management must prioritize modularity, reusability, and compliance with enterprise tools and standards, including machine-actionability for outputs.
Capability implication: Strategic and operational familiarity with enterprise dissemination architectures, governance frameworks, metadata standards, and automation pipelines is critical. Knowledge of integration and compliance processes becomes increasingly important.

Chief.title: Configure workflows
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages sections and project teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, and system/process implementation. The chief is responsible for planning long-term strategies, implementing new systems and processes, evaluating operational frameworks, and initiating changes to respond to client demands. Evidence: 'Implements new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifies new statistical methods, techniques and practices and evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems and processes.' and 'Establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems and processes.' Future GSBPM expectation: Transitioning to standardized, modular, and automated pipeline orchestration, with business enablement and auditable configuration, drastically changes operational oversight. The role must now assure that process changes are embedded in enterprise workflow platforms, empower business staff to adapt workflows, and enforce operational discipline, versioning, auditability, and compliance. Role evolution: The chief must shift from managing manually executed system/process change to strategic oversight of workflow orchestration platforms, supporting operational transformation, and embedding organizational requirements in self-service and automated environments. The chief will facilitate collaboration between IT and business areas, ensure operational discipline in versioning, and manage risks associated with business empowerment. Capability implication: Advanced understanding of workflow orchestration, platform operational models, automation, modular design, and operational governance will be central—enabling the translation of production system needs into scalable, auditable, and repeatable workflows.

Chief.title: Finalise production systems
Chief.justification: The Chief (EC-07, 900-217) manages a section and multidisciplinary project teams involved in statistical program operations, including implementing new systems and processes. The description, 'Implements new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifies new statistical methods, techniques and practices and evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems and processes,' evidences direct alignment with current production system finalization. The future GSBPM implication transforms this process to operationalizing modular, automated, AI-driven pipelines with version control, compliance, and continual monitoring, shared responsibility among operational, IT, and analytics teams, and much broader user enablement efforts. The Chief's role must evolve from technical sign-off and operational leadership to an ongoing stewardship of system operationalization, adaptivity, and compliance, while supporting interdisciplinary engagement and rapid update cycles. Capabilities will increasingly center on digital system modularity, operational monitoring, digital security postures, and enabling self-service and FAIR-compliant activities for all users.

Chief.title: Create frame and select sample
Chief.justification: The EC-07 Chief position is tasked with establishing and maintaining frameworks for the operation of statistical systems and processes, including the collection, processing, editing, compilation, analysis, and dissemination of outputs (“Establishes and maintains a framework for the development and on-going operation of statistical systems and processes and evaluates and incorporates all the functions and activities associated”). Importantly, the role initiates changes and implements new systems and processes, identifies and assesses new statistical methods and the availability and reliability of new data sources for statistical programs. Under GSBPM 4.1’s future state, the Chief will move from managing manual sample draws or static frame-based operations to overseeing automated, AI-enabled modules for frame and sample creation, intervening only for complex exceptions. Their decision-making will need to center on process oversight, continuous improvement, and cross-program harmonization of sample coordination, including burden management and platform-based optimization. Therefore, the position will see a heightened need for capabilities in evaluating algorithmic sampling outcomes, ensuring system auditability and transparency, and advancing methodological innovation in automated, data-driven sample-related decisions.

Chief.title: Set up collection
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages sections or multidisciplinary teams responsible for establishing and maintaining frameworks for statistical systems and processes, which include the development and operation of data collection activities. Their role explicitly includes initiating changes, implementing new systems and processes to meet client demands, assessing new statistical methods and technologies, and defining priorities for integration and interpretation of large volumes of data. Future GSBPM expectation: Collection set-up is heavily automated, requiring oversight of enterprise workflows, AI logic, and quality/risk management, with less reliance on manual configuration or staff training for each new initiative. Role evolution: Chiefs will move from actively planning and implementing instrument deployment and training toward monitoring automated pipelines, validating new AI-enabled system outputs and logic, and directing resources toward rare exceptions or integrations that fall outside templates. They must ensure that automation operates ethically, securely, and with high quality—shifting their function toward oversight, governance, and innovation. Capability implication: Chiefs need evaluative and governance expertise in platform automation, emergent data collection technologies, AI quality and risk monitoring, and must understand how to govern rapid, modular processes and intervene appropriately in non-routine cases.

Chief.title: Run collection
Chief.justification:
Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief oversees sections and multidisciplinary teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, and system development, including 'evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems and processes.' The role is responsible for 'initiating changes and implementing new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifying and assessing new statistical methods, techniques and practices and the associated costs and limitations, identifying the availability and reliability of new data sources, evaluating the suitability of new hardware and software.'
Future GSBPM expectation: The 'Run collection' phase is becoming an orchestrated, predominantly automated, AI-enabled pipeline that prioritizes administrative and alternative data, relegating surveys to infrequent, system-mediated exceptions. Monitoring, dynamic adjustment, and multi-source orchestration through digital dashboards will dominate.
Role evolution: The Chief's responsibilities will need to shift from directing traditional manual collection operations to managing the integration, real-time monitoring, and system refinement of automated, multi-source pipelines. The Chief will need to set strategy for automation platforms, oversee the coordination of simultaneous automated data streams, and organize exception-handling protocols for edge cases where human intervention is still essential. Decision-making moves from survey logistics and fieldwork management to orchestrating digital collection and ensuring AI-driven workflows are optimized, monitored, and aligned with departmental priorities.
Capability implication: Deep understanding of automation technologies, digital data acquisition architectures (APIs, administrative feeds), real-time monitoring and dashboard interpretation, managing AI-powered collection systems, and designing and governing exception handling procedures become central to this role.

Chief.title: Integrate data
Chief.justification: The 'Chief' (EC-07) manages sections and multidisciplinary project teams in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, marketing, and dissemination, and is responsible for implementing new systems and processes (e.g., 'Implements new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifies new statistical methods, techniques and practices and evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems and processes'). This role currently guides integration through hands-on, custom methods—evaluating new data sources and manually resolving compatibility issues. Under the future GSBPM, integration operates through automated, event-driven, metadata-governed platforms. The Chief must shift from micromanaging data harmonization and overseeing manual pipeline construction to architecting and managing modular, auditable integration systems, configuring and validating metadata-driven interfaces, and establishing rules for exception handling. Decision-making centers on configuring standardized pipeline logic and managing cross-domain deployability, reducing the need for manual data manipulation. Capabilities in pipeline orchestration, metadata governance, and exception management become central, as well as strategic leadership in the adoption of industry-wide interoperability and auditability standards.

Chief.title: Review and validate
Chief.justification: The Chief (EC-07) manages statistical program operations, oversees analysis, interpretation, dissemination, and 'plans and manages the review and evaluation of statistical program methods and concepts to certify the overall quality and completeness of program results, to improve existing data, to develop new techniques and methods of producing, evaluating and analyzing data.' As GSBPM 5.3 repositions validation as a program-wide, automated process, the Chief must move from supervising manual checks and adjudicating quality issues post-validation, to providing leadership and oversight for pipelines that embed automated, auditable validation modules, focusing on the strategic deployment and monitoring of AI-enabled validation logic, managing exceptions, and ensuring governance, auditability, and cross-domain consistency. This elevates requirements for strategic oversight of automation, pipeline governance, and enterprise-scale quality assurance in automated workflows.

Chief.title: Derive new variables and units
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages a section or multidisciplinary teams overseeing statistical program operations, analysis, and development of new systems or methods to improve data production and utilization. Responsibilities include evaluating and implementing new systems and processes, integrating statistical functions (collection, processing, derivation), and initiating changes to meet client demands. They set strategic directions, propose innovative solutions, and manage procedures and frameworks for ongoing operations, including manual derivation of variables and integration of new approaches. Future GSBPM expectation: Derivation of new variables will be managed as embedded, metadata-driven modules within orchestrated, reproducible pipelines. The Chief will guide the shift away from custom, manual derivations toward standardized, automated transformation services, ensuring program decisions support modularization, reuse, and auditability across domains. Role evolution: Leadership and operational management moves from overseeing manual workflows to architecting and governing modular, automated services. The Chief is accountable for implementing and maintaining pipelines that automate derivation logic, standardization, exception handling, and traceability. This demands strategic governance over system integration, compliance, and rapid deployment of transformation modules. Capability implication: A foundational understanding of metadata governance, modular pipeline architecture, and systemic audit/compliance requirements becomes critical. The Chief must be equipped to drive cross-domain adoption of standardized logic, impact analysis for modular deployments, and quality stewardship within fully automated production environments.

Chief.title: Calculate weights
Chief.justification: The Chief (EC-07) is accountable for 'managing, through subordinates, the work of a section and/or multidisciplinary project teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, marketing and dissemination' and for 'implementing new systems and processes to meet client demands' and 'evaluates and incorporates all the functions and activities associated with the data collection, processing, editing, compilation, analysis and dissemination'. Weight calculation as a modular, automated service demands that the Chief manage transition from manual processes to fully orchestrated, reproducible modules, integrating weighting logic with AI features. The Chief will be responsible for overseeing the integration and auditing of weight calculation within broader data pipelines, setting standards, managing cross-domain compatibility, and leading large-scale change management as manual touchpoints are replaced with digital governance. Their decisions and operational planning will need to address system-level requirements, version control, and performance monitoring across automated services. Capabilities needed will center on digital governance, orchestration, auditability, and the strategic harmonization of weighting across multiple domains and programs.

Chief.title: Calculate aggregates
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief manages statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination, establishes frameworks and strategic directions for statistical systems, implements new systems and processes, and manages studies covering a range of programs. Manages and reviews aggregation approaches as part of system development and quality oversight. Future GSBPM expectation: Aggregation becomes a standardized, automated microservice operation, requiring chiefs to prioritize governance of modular, metadata-driven pipelines, ensure auditability, transparency, and compliance, and lead teams in configuring aggregation modules while moving away from custom aggregation scripts or one-off solutions. They must supervise exception handling, validation, and interpretive activities as automated systems generate results across domains. Role evolution: Chiefs transition from overseeing custom aggregation development to managing system configuration, monitoring automated pipeline validity, and directing staff to focus on quality assurance, audit trails, and the interpretation of AI-driven results. They will be responsible for change management and governance processes supporting pipeline standardization and reproducibility. Capability implication: Understanding the architecture of automated, event-driven aggregation pipelines, mastery of metadata and versioning principles, governance mechanisms for auditability, and the ability to support staff in interpreting automated outputs become core competencies.

Chief.title: Prepare draft outputs
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief 'manages a section and/or multidisciplinary project teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, marketing and dissemination' and 'implements new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifies new statistical methods, techniques and practices and evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems and processes'. This role includes strategic leadership over the preparation and review of outputs and operational design of production pipelines. Future GSBPM expectation: The Chief will direct, through subordinates, teams focused on automated analytical pipelines, integrating AI-enabled output production into operational routines, and ensuring the quality, reproducibility, and auditability of results. Role evolution: Strategic leadership shifts toward overseeing the transition, maintenance, and enhancement of automated output preparation, setting performance standards, and advancing system oversight and exception resolution capabilities. Capability implication: The role will require expertise in managing and governing highly automated analytical environments, agile adaptation to new AI workflows, and comprehensive quality assurance for automated statistical outputs.

Chief.title: Interpret and explain outputs
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief manages multidisciplinary teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, dissemination, and marketing, and provides expert advisory services on the results and their impact on policy issues ("Provides expert advisory and consultative services to senior officials and policy makers at all levels of government...on the practical application and interpretation of statistical data, on advanced analytical methods, concepts and techniques..."). Future GSBPM expectation: Chiefs will direct teams whose main output is interpretation and contextualization of automated results, assuring that AI-driven analysis is accurately and responsibly explained, its societal and policy relevance is made clear, and oversight mechanisms are in place for transparency and fairness. Role evolution: Chiefs must guide teams to focus on narrative-building, evidence-based communication, and ethical oversight, rather than technical manipulation. They will be responsible for embedding human oversight frameworks and maintaining trust in automated analytic outputs. Capability implication: Enhanced requirements for domain-specific oversight, ethical and transparency assurance in AI analytics, and advanced communication of complex findings.

Chief.title: Apply disclosure control
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages sections and teams involved in statistical operations, sets strategic directions, oversees data collection/processing/editing/analysis/dissemination, and establishes security and confidentiality policies ('Establishes policies and procedures for the security and confidentiality of data ...'). Future GSBPM expectation: Automation and orchestration of disclosure control means these policies must be embedded programmatically, with real-time monitoring, escalation, and audit trails. Role evolution: The Chief's role evolves from setting manual workflow and policy to guiding teams that develop, maintain, and oversee automated disclosure control systems and processes, ensuring division-wide policy compliance across new dissemination modalities and rapid-response needs. Capability implication: Greater emphasis on auditability, system oversight, and cross-functional coordination for disclosure control implementation, plus the ability to evaluate or adjust embedded rules, monitor automated exception logs, and proactively assess risk in new dissemination channels.

Chief.title: GSBPM 6.5 Finalise Outputs
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The Chief manages sections/teams involved in statistical operations, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination, sets strategic directions, evaluates systems and processes, reviews and certifies quality and completeness of program results, and implements operational changes. Evidence includes: 'Manages a section and/or multidisciplinary project teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, marketing and dissemination,' and 'Plans and manages the review and evaluation of statistical program methods and concepts to certify the overall quality and completeness of program results.' Future GSBPM expectation: Output finalization and readiness for dissemination will be systematized and automated, requiring less manual review and more oversight, exception management, and strategic sign-off where AI and orchestration accelerate and standardize output preparation. Role evolution: Chiefs will transition from manual supervision of output preparation to monitoring automated pipelines, making judgment calls on flagged exceptions, and maintaining program quality via strategic oversight rather than direct administrative review. Capability implication: Capabilities in evaluating automated process outputs, auditing system-generated flags and caveats, and governance of automated approval and dissemination workflows will become more significant. Familiarity with orchestrated analytical pipelines and trust management for automation will be increasingly emphasized.

Chief.title: Update output systems
Chief.justification:
Current responsibility: The 'Chief' (EC-07) manages sections and project teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, marketing, and dissemination. They plan and implement long-term strategies for statistical program development and oversee the implementation of new systems and processes, including evaluation of cost, efficiency, and productivity, and review and presentation of findings. Evidence: 'Implements new systems and processes to meet client demands, identifies new statistical methods, techniques and practices and evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems and processes.'

Future GSBPM expectation: System updates for output will shift from distributed, program-specific activities to systematic, platform-driven, automation-led and centrally governed operations. Output formats and their dissemination should comply with enterprise standards for metadata, APIs, machine-actionability, and real-time access.

Role evolution: The Chief's responsibility for system implementation and outputs will transition to overseeing the alignment of multiple programmatic teams with centralized enterprise dissemination platforms. They will focus on ensuring compliance, orchestrating exception handling, integrating output requirements via metadata specifications, and providing operational oversight at the platform level, rather than managing hands-on dissemination processes.

Capability implication: Greater depth in platform-level system integration, metadata-driven governance, and compliance with enterprise interoperability standards for dissemination is required. Ability to coordinate across programs, ensure modular component compatibility, and steward real-time, machine-actionable output delivery will be central, as will a strong grasp of FAIR principles and API publication.

Chief.title: Release dissemination products
Chief.justification:
Current responsibility: The 'Chief (EC-07)' manages multidisciplinary project teams for statistical program operations, analysis, marketing, and dissemination, implements new systems and processes, and evaluates the cost, efficiency and productivity of divisional statistical systems ('Manages a section and/or multidisciplinary project teams ... dissemination', 'Establishes and maintains a framework ... dissemination of the division's statistical outputs').
Future GSBPM expectation: As dissemination becomes automated and managed via IT-maintained corporate platforms, the Chief's responsibility will shift towards governance, support of exception scenarios, strategic oversight of platform resilience and compliance, and engagement with workflow design and system auditability for dissemination. The Chief will also have greater accountability for policy compliance, security of embargoed releases, and reliable execution of critical releases.
Role evolution: Oversight of operational activities moves from manual and team-based coordination to monitoring of automated workflows, managing exception handling protocols, supporting organizational adoption of platform-centric dissemination, and developing policies and practices for operational resilience and process transparency.
Capability implication: Critical knowledge includes platform-based workflow governance, exception management, system auditability, embargo logic, and digital operational resilience, with a reduced focus on direct manual coordination and increased focus on oversight and system improvement.

Chief.title: Promote dissemination products
Chief.justification: Current responsibility: The EC-07 Chief manages teams involved in statistical program operations, analysis, interpretation, marketing and dissemination. The role includes 'plans and implements long term strategies for the development, enhancement and operation of statistical programs,' and actively manages marketing and dissemination. Future GSBPM expectation: The new paradigm for promoting dissemination products demands digital-first, machine-actionable formats and automated promotion strategies (APIs, AI-driven segmentation, automated notifications), replacing manual campaign management. Role evolution: The Chief must transition from designing and implementing traditional outreach strategies to governing automated promotion logic, curating machine-actionable metadata, integrating APIs for omni-channel delivery, and using real-time data analytics to evaluate outreach effectiveness and adapt strategies. Capability implication: This role will require competencies in digital content governance, metadata curation, machine-discoverable publication logic, and practical understanding of engagement monitoring and personalization in a digital ecosystem.

Chief.title: Gather evaluation inputs
Chief.justification:
Current responsibility: The Chief (EC-07) manages comprehensive programs of analysis and evaluation across sectors and departments to improve existing data, develop new methods of producing, evaluating and analyzing data, and to extend the application of divisional statistics. This includes planning and managing the review and evaluation of statistical program methods and concepts to certify the overall quality and completeness of program results, and to improve data and production systems (see: 'Plans and manages the review and evaluation of statistical program methods and concepts...'). Traditionally, these activities have depended on manually gathered inputs from surveys, process reviews, and client feedback, with the Chief overseeing the compilation and assessment of these materials.
Future GSBPM expectation: Under StatCan2030's vision, continuous, system-driven, and automated collection of evaluation inputs becomes a default feature of the architecture. Evaluation inputs are captured in real time from production systems via embedded instrumentation, removing the need for periodic manual compilation, and staff must shift their focus to monitoring dashboards, configuring quality indicators, and interpreting system-generated anomaly alerts.
Role evolution: The Chief's responsibilities evolve from leading efforts to manually gather and synthesize evaluation inputs for quality assessment toward ensuring that systems are instrumented for the automatic generation of standardized, actionable evaluation material (paradata, system metrics, user interactions). The role becomes more about oversight of system outputs and interpretation of performance indicators, requiring intervention only where exceptions or unexplained phenomena arise in automated surveillance.
Capability implication: It becomes crucial for the Chief to possess advanced understanding of the operational logic and data exhaust of automated statistical systems, skills in designing and refining quality indicators and dashboards, and ability to interpret paradata and system metrics relevant to statistical process evaluation.

Chief.title: Conduct evaluation
